t: Above you is One Blackfriars, a mixed-use development at number 1 Blackfriars Road, in Bankside. Its shape has earned it two nicknames: the Vase and the Boomerang. It was designed by Ian Simpson, an English architect and one of the partners of SimpsonHaugh, the practice he set up in 1987 with Rachel Haugh. If you stand back and look at the outline, you can probably see how each of the nicknames came about.
